title: Add Schedule and Doctor transport to the PHP SDK
description:
The PHP SDK exposes typed requests and immutable responses for the eight Schedule operations and the Schedule-enabled Doctor family set, transporting bounded values without owning Schedule or Doctor policy. The operations are in [ADR 0013](<https://github.com/nckrtl/orbit/blob/main/docs/decisions/0013-native-systemd-schedule-management.md>).

## Scope

* In: typed requests and responses for Schedule list, add, show, run, logs, complete, remove, and activate, with Node and AppInstance target shapes
* In: bounding and redaction of command, log, identifier, error, nested, and request-ID values on the response boundary
* In: Doctor family types for the Schedule-enabled family set
* In: the transport tests, public-operation inventory, guidance, and README
* Out: target resolution, systemd, shell, Schedule policy, Doctor policy, and ambiguity handling
* Out: Workspace targets, CLI presentation, raw responses, transport debug data, Gateway, deployment, and harness changes

## Acceptance

- [ ] Each of the eight operations sends the exact method, path, query, and body the Gateway expects and encodes the UUID path segment safely. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Requests/Schedules/ScheduleRequestsTest.php`.
- [ ] Node and AppInstance target shapes serialize distinctly, an omitted option is absent from the request, and an explicit invalid value is sent for Gateway validation. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Requests/Schedules/ScheduleRequestsTest.php`.
- [ ] Log and command values in responses stay bounded, credentials are redacted, and malformed nested data is rejected. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Responses/Schedules/ScheduleResponsesTest.php`.
- [ ] Doctor accepts exactly the family tokens on `origin/main`, including `schedule`, without a hard-coded family count. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Responses/Doctor/DoctorReportResponseTest.php`.
- [ ] The public-operation inventory grows by exactly the eight Schedule operations and its test derives the total from the pre-Schedule count. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/RepositoryGuidanceTest.php`.
- [ ] The PHP SDK transport reference and README state the Schedule operations and the Schedule-enabled Doctor contract, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] PHP SDK checks pass. Proof: `cd packages/php-sdk && composer check`.
- [ ] The SDK public-contract guide permits the shipped typed Schedule operations and Schedule Doctor token instead of prohibiting them; its restrictions on unimplemented deployment surfaces are changed only by the deployment transport work. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/RepositoryGuidanceTest.php`.
- [ ] Focused acceptance tests pass, and an independent reviewer retains the exact-candidate local quality receipt across all five projects. Proof: the focused suites named above and root `composer check` with test impact analysis.
- [ ] Typed add requests preserve omitted versus explicit `start` values, activation uses `POST /schedules/{uuid}/activate`, and responses validate `desired_timer_state` independently of lifecycle state without inferring policy. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Requests/Schedules/ScheduleRequestsTest.php` and `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Responses/Schedules/ScheduleResponsesTest.php`.
